description_en: Calls the UnassociateVpcCidrBlock operation to delete a secondary CIDR block from a VPC
kebab_example: aliyun vpc unassociate-vpc-cidr-block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-o6wrloqsdqc9io3mg0000 --secondary-cidr-block 192.168.0.0/16 --ipv6-cidr-block 2408:XXXX:0:6a::/56 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassociateVpcCidrBlock

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the VPC from which you want to delete a secondary CIDR block. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
要删除附加网段的VPC所在地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
